claims.statement: drizzle.config.ts is the single source of truth for migration generation: it points drizzle-kit at schema source `./lib/db/schema.ts`, output directory `./lib/db/migrations`, dialect `postgresql`, and the connection URL `process.env.POSTGRES_URL` (a non-null assertion).

lib/db/migrations is committed to the repository and currently contains 22 ordered SQL migrations numbered 0000 through 0021, plus a `meta/` directory whose `_journal.json` declares `version: "7"` and `dialect: "postgresql"` and lists one entry per migration with its index, slug tag, and creation timestamp; alongside the journal sits one `NNNN_snapshot.json` per migration.

Drizzle-generated migration SQL files separate statements with the standard `---> statement-breakpoint` marker (for example, in 0010_concerned_exodus.sql, which adds users/accounts/keys tables, foreign keys, and unique indexes in a single migration).

package.json exposes four migration scripts that map one-to-one to drizzle-kit subcommands: `db:generate` -> `drizzle-kit generate`, `db:migrate` -> `drizzle-kit migrate`, `db:push` -> `drizzle-kit push`, and `db:studio` -> `drizzle-kit studio`.

scripts/migrate-production.ts gates migration execution on `process.env.VERCEL_ENV === 'production'`. When the check fails the script logs a skip message, prints the current environment (defaulting to `local`), and `process.exit(0)`, so it is a safe no-op on local developer machines, Vercel preview deployments (VERCEL_ENV=preview), Vercel development deployments (VERCEL_ENV=development), and any CI runner that does not explicitly set `VERCEL_ENV=production`.

Inside the production branch, scripts/migrate-production.ts re-verifies that `POSTGRES_URL` is set (throwing `Error: POSTGRES_URL environment variable is required` otherwise) and then runs `npx drizzle-kit migrate` via `child_process.execSync` with `stdio: 'inherit'` and the current `process.env` forwarded. On success it logs a completion message and exits 0; any thrown error from execSync is caught, logged with `console.error`, and converted to `process.exit(1)` so the surrounding build pipeline fails the deploy.

The same `POSTGRES_URL` connection string is consumed by three call sites: drizzle-kit via `drizzle.config.ts`, the production migration runner scripts/migrate-production.ts (which forwards `process.env` to the child process), and the runtime database proxy in lib/db/client.ts which lazily opens a `postgres-js` connection and throws if POSTGRES_URL is missing. POSTGRES_URL is provisioned automatically on Vercel via the Neon integration declared in vercel-template.json.
